4xOP01-016            (OPTCG Sim format)
2 OP01-025_p1 JP      (alt art, Japanese)
OP05-119 x3           (quantity after)
CSV with columns like: code, quantity, language

cardsPage.title: Cards
cardsPage.subtitle: Every set and deck, newest release first. Search to find any card.

landing.lead: Yonko is a checklist for the One Piece Card Game. Tick off every printing you own — English and Japanese, alt arts and all — then paste any decklist to see what you can build and what’s missing.
landing.sampleNote: Sample marks. Yours fill in as you collect.

own.title: Tick off what you own
own.body: Tap through any set, or paste a list or spreadsheet. Base, alt art, manga, reprints, English and Japanese: every printing is tracked, and all of them count toward your playset.

paste.title: Paste a decklist
paste.body: From OPTCG Sim or any deckbuilder. Any printing of a card fills its slot, so your alt arts count.

missing.title: See what’s missing
missing.body: What you already own for the deck, and exactly what’s missing — copy it straight into a shop order.

landing.checkTitle: Owned or missing, card by card
landing.checkBody: Four slots per card, like a playset. Marked: you own it. Red: you still need it. Alt arts and Japanese copies fill the same slots. Hold back cards sleeved in decks you’ve already built, or check with English cards only for official events.
landing.closingBody: Pick the set you’ve opened the most packs of and tick it off. It takes a few minutes, and it’s free.

rules.OnPlay: Activates when this card is played.
rules.ActivateMain: You may activate this during your Main Phase, outside of battle.
rules.Main: Event: you may use this card during your Main Phase.
rules.OnKO: Activates when this Character is K.O.’d.
rules.OnBlock: Activates when this card blocks an attack.
rules.EndofYourTurn: Activates at the end of your turn.
rules.EndofYourOpponentsTurn: Activates at the end of your opponent’s turn.
rules.YourTurn: This effect applies only during your turn.
rules.OpponentsTurn: This effect applies only during your opponent’s turn.
rules.Counter: Event: you may use this during your opponent’s attack (the Counter Step) to protect your Leader or a Character.
rules.Trigger: When this card is revealed from your Life because you took damage, you may activate this effect instead of adding the card to your hand.
rules.Blocker: When your opponent attacks, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.
rules.Rush: This card can attack on the turn it is played.
rules.RushCharacter: This card can attack Characters (not the Leader) on the turn it is played.
rules.DoubleAttack: When this card deals damage, it deals 2 damage instead of 1.
rules.Banish: When this card deals damage, the Life card is trashed instead of going to the hand, and its [Trigger] can’t be activated.
rules.Unblockable: Your opponent can’t activate [Blocker] when this card attacks.
rules.OncePerTurn: This effect can be activated only once per turn.
rules.donX: This effect works only while this card has at least that many DON!! cards given to it.

legality.bannedNote: On Bandai’s ban list ({{date}}): not playable in Standard or Extra, in any printing.

legality.extraNote: Rotated out of Standard (current window: Blocks {{blocks}}); still legal in Extra, where every card can be played.
